query:
UPDATE accounts
                   SET inbox_url = CASE WHEN $2 != '' THEN $2 ELSE inbox_url END,
                       shared_inbox_url = COALESCE($3, shared_inbox_url),
                       public_key = CASE WHEN $4 != '' AND NOT $5 THEN $4 ELSE public_key END,
                       updated_at = now()
                   WHERE id = $1
